en.t: New app 'The Mall' builds a universal feed for online shopping
en.d: It gathers brands from thousands of retailers into one personalized feed, tracking sales and drops.
en.body:
The Mall is a new app designed to simplify the fragmented landscape of online shopping by consolidating thousands of retailers into one unified interface. Rather than navigating multiple platforms or browser tabs, users build a personalized feed centered on their favorite brands, then receive real-time updates about sales, promotions, and product launches. The app essentially acts as a discovery aggregator, mirroring social media's success with feeds by applying the same principle to commerce. This centralization offers users convenience while potentially reducing friction in the path to purchase.

For e-commerce sellers and retailers, The Mall represents a new channel for product visibility and customer acquisition. Brands gain exposure to users who may not have visited their individual storefronts, while the app handles the infrastructure of feed management and notification delivery. Smaller merchants especially benefit from this exposure model, which can level the playing field against larger competitors who dominate traditional search results or paid advertising channels.

The app reflects a broader industry shift toward feed-based discovery in shopping. As consumers spend increasing time on social platforms and feed-driven apps, commerce platforms are adopting similar patterns to capture and retain attention. The success of The Mall may signal growing demand for a unified shopping interface—one that prioritizes personalization and real-time engagement over traditional catalog browsing.

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/a-new-app-the-mall-is-building-a-universal-feed-for-online-shopping/

tr.t: Amazon'a rakip lojistik girişimi Stord 250 milyon dolar topladı
tr.d: E-ticaret fulfillment ağı Stord, 3 milyar dolar değerleme ile yatırım aldı.
tr.body:
E-ticaret markaları için depo ağı ve stok yönetim yazılımı sunan Stord, 3 milyar dolarlık değerleme üzerinden 250 milyon dolar yatırım aldı. Şirket kendini 'Amazon karşıtı' olarak konumlandırıyor; markalara hızlı teslimat kapasitesi sunarken müşteri ilişkisinin markada kalmasını vaat ediyor. Bu model, büyüyen e-ticaret sektöründe bağımsız lojistik altyapısına olan talebi ortaya koymaktadır. Pek çok markanın Amazon FBA hizmetlerinden uzaklaşması, kendi müşteri verilerine ve ticari ilişkilerine tam kontrol sahibi olmak istemesiyle ilgilidir.

Stord'un yaklaşımı, hızlı büyüyen bağımsız satıcılar ve orta ölçekli e-ticaret işletmeleri için alternatif bir yol açmaktadır. Şirketin yazılım altyapısı, merkezileştirilmiş lojistiğin sağladığı hızı, daha esnek ve şeffaf bir ortamda sunmayı hedeflemektedir. Bu tür platform modellerinin gelişmesi, sektörde yapısal bir kaymayı işaret etmektedir: markaların lojistik seçiminde daha fazla özerklik ve veri sahipliğine önem vermesi.

Fon turası aynı zamanda risk sermayesi dünyasının bu sektöre olan güvenini göstermektedir. en.t: Amazon fulfillment rival Stord raises $250M at $3B valuation
en.d: The e-commerce fulfillment network lands fresh funding as demand for independent logistics grows.
en.body:
Stord, which offers a network of warehouses and inventory-management software for e-commerce brands, has raised $250 million at a $3 billion valuation. The company positions itself as a sort of 'anti-Amazon,' giving brands the speed to compete while letting them keep ownership of the customer relationship. This model reflects a growing demand for independent fulfillment infrastructure among a diverse base of sellers who seek alternatives to dominant platform-controlled logistics systems. Many merchants are increasingly wary of vendor lock-in and prefer retaining full control over their customer data and order fulfillment strategies.

Stord's proposition is opening pathways for independent sellers and mid-market e-commerce operators seeking flexibility without sacrificing delivery performance. The software layer underpinning its warehouse network aims to deliver the velocity that centralized logistics provides, but within a framework that grants brands greater autonomy and transparency. This shift signals a structural change in how merchants evaluate fulfillment partners, with data ownership and operational control now competing alongside pure speed as key decision factors.

The funding round underscores rising confidence among investors in specialized logistics alternatives. As traditional carriers and platform-dominated fulfillment networks consolidate power, new-generation operators like Stord are earning serious capital attention. Continued venture backing for comparable models appears likely, especially as e-commerce fragmentation and merchant independence remain countervailing forces against centralization.

fr.t: Stord, rival d'Amazon dans la logistique, lève 250 M$ à 3 Md$ de valorisation
fr.d: Le réseau de fulfillment e-commerce obtient de nouveaux fonds alors que la demande de logistique indépendante augmente.
fr.body:
Stord, qui propose un réseau d'entrepôts et un logiciel de gestion des stocks pour les marques e-commerce, a levé 250 millions de dollars pour une valorisation de 3 milliards. L'entreprise se présente comme une sorte d'« anti-Amazon » : elle offre aux marques la rapidité nécessaire pour rivaliser tout en leur laissant la maîtrise de la relation client. Ce modèle reflète une demande croissante d'infrastructures de fulfillment indépendantes chez des vendeurs en quête d'alternatives aux systèmes logistiques contrôlés par les grandes plateformes. De nombreux marchands redoutent de plus en plus l'effet de dépendance envers une plateforme et préfèrent conserver un contrôle total sur leurs données clients et leurs stratégies de logistique.

La proposition de Stord ouvre des voies pour les vendeurs indépendants et les entreprises e-commerce de taille moyenne à la recherche de flexibilité sans sacrifier la performance de livraison. La couche logicielle qui sous-tend son réseau d'entrepôts vise à fournir la vélocité qu'offre la logistique centralisée, mais dans un cadre accordant aux marques une plus grande autonomie et transparence. Ce changement signale une mutation structurelle dans la façon dont les marchands évaluent leurs partenaires logistiques, la propriété des données et le contrôle opérationnel rivalisant désormais avec la seule vitesse comme facteurs décisionnels clés.

Le tour de table souligne la confiance croissante des investisseurs dans les alternatives logistiques spécialisées. Alors que les acteurs traditionnels et les réseaux de fulfillment dominés par les plateformes consolident leur pouvoir, les nouveaux modèles opérationnels comme Stord attirent des capitaux importants. Un soutien continu du capital-risque pour des solutions comparables semble probable, particulièrement car la fragmentation du e-commerce et l'indépendance des marchands demeurent des forces contrecarrant la centralisation.

it.t: Stord, rivale di Amazon nella logistica, raccoglie 250 mln $ a una valutazione di 3 mld
it.d: La rete di fulfillment per l'e-commerce ottiene nuovi fondi mentre cresce la domanda di logistica indipendente.
it.body:
Stord, che offre una rete di magazzini e software di gestione dell'inventario per i brand e-commerce, ha raccolto 250 milioni di dollari a una valutazione di 3 miliardi. L'azienda si posiziona come una sorta di 'anti-Amazon': dà ai brand la velocità per competere lasciando loro la proprietà della relazione con il cliente. Questo modello riflette la crescente domanda di infrastrutture di fulfillment indipendenti tra venditori che cercano alternative ai sistemi logistici controllati da piattaforme dominanti. Molti commercianti temono sempre più la dipendenza da fornitori e preferiscono conservare il pieno controllo sui dati dei clienti e sulle strategie di fulfillment.

La proposta di Stord apre percorsi per venditori indipendenti e aziende di e-commerce di medie dimensioni che cercano flessibilità senza sacrificare le prestazioni di consegna. Il layer software che sostiene la sua rete di magazzini mira a fornire la velocità che offre la logistica centralizzata, ma all'interno di un framework che concede ai brand maggiore autonomia e trasparenza. Questo cambiamento segnala una trasformazione strutturale nel modo in cui i commercianti valutano i partner logistici, con la proprietà dei dati e il controllo operativo ora in competizione con la pura velocità come fattori decisionali chiave.

Lo stanziamento di capitale sottolinea la crescente fiducia degli investitori nelle alternative logistiche specializzate. Mentre gli attori tradizionali e le reti di fulfillment dominate da piattaforme consolidano il loro potere, nuovi modelli operativi come Stord attirano capitali significativi. Il continuo sostegno del venture capital per soluzioni comparabili appare probabile, soprattutto perché la frammentazione dell'e-commerce e l'indipendenza dei commercianti rimangono forze che si oppongono alla centralizzazione.
